title: StitchScope Vision Proposal (multi-region)
description: The structured shape a vision-model response must conform to before StitchScope's reconstruction engine will validate it. Supersedes proposal_schema_v1.json: v1 assumed one stitch pattern per photo, but a real garment photo can show 2-3 different stitch regions (e.g. a fan panel and a mesh panel), so v2 makes 'regions' the top-level list and moves stitch_family/confidence/rows/uncertain_fields down to each region. engine/schema.py enforces these same rules in plain Python.

photo_id.description: Optional label for the source photo/crop this proposal came from.

regions.description: One entry per distinct stitch pattern detected in the photo.

region_label.description: Where this stitch pattern is on the garment, e.g. 'center panel' or 'fan panel (left)'.

stitch_family.description: Human-readable name for the guessed stitch pattern, e.g. 'filet mesh'.

confidence.description: The model's own confidence in this region's guess, 0-1. Metadata about the guess, not validated for correctness.

uncertain_fields.description: Names of fields the model is unsure about for this region, e.g. 'stitch_count'. Empty list means confident in everything proposed for this region.

setup.description: The one-time steps worked before the repeat starts. Can be empty.

repeat.description: The unit that repeats across the rest of the row. Never empty.

repeat_count.description: How many times the proposal claims the repeat is worked. The engine checks this claim against stitches actually available -- it is not free to adjust it to make the row fit.
